# Русская Рамаяна

> Archive of Russian Ramāyaṇa translations and the project of completing the first full poetic academic translation of Vālmīki's Rāmāyaṇa from Sanskrit — «Гринцер начал, Леонов продолжает».

## Overview

- [Project home](https://gasyoun.github.io/RussianRamayana/) · [About the project](https://gasyoun.github.io/RussianRamayana/project.html) · [How to cite](https://gasyoun.github.io/RussianRamayana/cite.html) · [Support](https://gasyoun.github.io/RussianRamayana/support.html)

- [Recensions](https://gasyoun.github.io/RussianRamayana/recensions.html) · [Reception](https://gasyoun.github.io/RussianRamayana/reception.html) · [Bibliography](https://gasyoun.github.io/RussianRamayana/bibliography.html)
